newsitem.title: USA: Timken spends $30 mln, expands production.
newsitem.headline: Timken spends $30 mln, expands production.

text.p: Timken Co said Monday it plans to invest $30 million to expand its steel manufacturing capability and increase its product lines.
The investments include a $15 million profile ring mill in Columbus, N.C., that will produce shaped rings for the bearings industry, the company said.
The company said it will also build a $15 million hot-forming facility to make forged bearing components from Timken steel bars. A site for the facility has not yet been found, the company said.
